title: UPI callbacks delayed from partner bank
alert: upi-switch callback latency p99 9.1s for SBI, pending transactions growing
root cause: SBI was degraded on the payment switch and our retries doubled the load on it
fix: Enabled the bank-level circuit breaker for SBI and showed a "bank is slow" banner in the app

title: OTP delivery dropped
alert: otp-service delivery_rate=55%, sms-gateway-a responding 429 Too Many Requests
root cause: A marketing push during the Diwali sale used the same SMS route as OTPs and gateway A throttled us
fix: Failed over OTP traffic to sms-gateway-b and resumed the campaign in batches

title: Merchant webhooks rejected
alert: merchant-webhooks signature verification failed for most merchants
root cause: A signing secret rotation was not propagated to the webhook sender
failed fixes: Resending all failed webhooks at once (merchants rate-limited us)
fix: Updated the secret and replayed failed webhooks at 20 per second

title: UPI collect requests timing out
alert: HikariPool-1 connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. p99 latency 7.9s
root cause: maxPoolSize was 20 and idle-in-transaction sessions held connections open during the salary-day peak
fix: Killed idle-in-transaction sessions and raised maxPoolSize from 20 to 60

title: Customers charged twice
alert: Duplicate debits reported; card 5241 7730 1182 9054, customer phone 9988776655
root cause: Checkout retried after a gateway timeout without an idempotency key, so the charge ran twice
failed fixes: Issuing manual refunds one by one
